question: Please group all Italian customers into ten buckets for December 2021 by summing their profits from all products purchased (where profit is calculated as quantity_sold multiplied by the difference between unit_price and unit_cost), then divide the overall range of total monthly profits into ten equal intervals. For each bucket, provide the number of customers, and identify the minimum and maximum total profits within that bucket.
sql:
-- Final query with rounded values
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id, 
           SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) AS total_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52770
      AND p.time_id >= DATE '2021-12-01'
      AND p.time_id <= DATE '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
range_info AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_val, MAX(total_profit) AS max_val
    FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
           CASE 
               WHEN cp.total_profit = (SELECT max_val FROM range_info) THEN 10
               ELSE CAST(FLOOR((cp.total_profit - (SELECT min_val FROM range_info)) / (((SELECT max_val FROM range_info) - (SELECT min_val FROM range_info)) / 10.0)) + 1 AS INTEGER)
           END AS bucket
    FROM customer_profits cp
)
SELECT bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS min_profit_in_bucket,
       ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS max_profit_in_bucket
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
